subject: Phased remote-first transition & workspace accommodations for Maya Srinivasan
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: 3-week phased remote-first return + modest duty adjustments

Hi Jordan,

I hope you're doing ok. I'm planning to return from parental leave starting Monday, Dec 6, and wanted to request a short phased transition for the first three weeks to help with feeding schedules and medical follow-up. Proposed plan: 

- Week 1 (Dec 6–10): remote-first, on Slack/video for core overlap hours 10:00–16:00 PT; only essential onsite meetings.
- Week 2 (Dec 13–17): hybrid—2 onsite days (Tue/Thu), rest remote; reduced meeting load (no recurring >1 hour meetings).
- Week 3 (Dec 20–24): move back to normal schedule but continue flexible start times for pumping/appointments.

I also need two small workplace accommodations: daily access to a private lactation room (approx 20 minutes twice/day) and a laptop stand to reduce neck strain. I've attached the fit-to-work note from my provider which recommends light duty for one week and the lactation-room access request form.

Please let me know if this schedule is workable from a team perspective and if we should loop in Laura or anyone else for coverage during critical launches next week. Happy to hop on a 20-min sync to walk through coverage and handoffs.

Thank you — excited to be back and transition responsibly.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: fit_to_work_note.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)]
[Attachment: lactation-room-key-request.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week phased remote-first return + modest duty adjustments

Thanks for the note, Maya — congrats on the new baby and welcome back in advance. This sounds reasonable and responsible. A few quick items I want to confirm so we can make this official: 

1) Can you confirm your provider's recommended light-duty period length (the attached note looks like 7–10 days; HR will need the exact phrasing).
2) I will block a 20-min return-to-work sync for Friday 12/3 11:00–11:20 PT to walk through immediate handoffs (I invited Laura and Vivek).
3) I'll ask Monica to kick off the formal accommodation intake and DocuSign so we have opt-in for the lactation-room schedule and equipment request.

From a team perspective, we'll: 
- Move the Sprint Demo to Dec 10 daytime to avoid clashes with your remote overlap hours.
- Reassign on-call week of Dec 6 to Priya N. to avoid pager gaps; Priya and I will split postmortems.

Action items for me: create a short coverage doc and confirm laptop-stand procurement with IT. Monica/Vivek, over to you for the HR intake and facilities side.

Appreciate the heads-up — the proposed phased approach looks good to me if HR signs off.

—Jordan
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week phased remote-first return + modest duty adjustments

Hi all — thanks for the clear proposal, Maya. HR confirms we can support the phased schedule and the two modest accommodations (lactation room access and ergonomic equipment). Next steps from People Ops: 

- Please complete the short accommodation intake form (link below). Once submitted, People Ops will create a formal accommodation agreement and send via DocuSign for signatures.
- We have received the fit-to-work note; I will add it to your HR file. The provider noted light-duty for 7 days and intermittent pumping needs — that aligns with the three-week plan you proposed.
- Facilities will reserve the lactation room and issue an access card; Facilities may request the lactation-room-key-request.pdf to be re-submitted with building ID (we can do this on the sync).

Links & attachments: 
- Accommodation intake (HR form): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcExample/Redwood-Accommodations
- DocuSign return plan (coming): https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC123-ReturnPlan (I will send once the intake form is complete)
- Attached: placeholder copy of the DocuSign we will send (docusign-return-plan.pdf)

We will also confirm payroll adjustments for the first partial-pay week if needed — Vivek, can you confirm payroll timing for the partial return period?

Thanks — Monica
People Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: docusign-return-plan.pdf (PDF, 6 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week phased remote-first return + modest duty adjustments

Maya — quick follow-up after today's sync. Thanks for taking time to outline coverage during the call. Confirmations and owner list below: 

- Accommodation intake: Maya to submit intake form by EOD 12/3 (link in Monica's email).
- DocuSign: Monica to send accommodation agreement once intake is received (target 12/4).
- Facilities: reserve lactation room and issue temporary access (owner: Facilities; Monica to coordinate).
- IT: Ubuntu laptop stand + external mouse ordered (owner: IT procurement; Jordan to follow up).
- Team coverage: Priya N. will own on-call week of 12/6; Jordan and Priya will split escalations.

Attachments included to HR record: fit_to_work_note.pdf, lactation-room-key-request.pdf. Please add the DocuSign once it's delivered.

If anything changes with appointments or medical advice, loop Monica first so People Ops can update the accommodation agreement. Thanks again and welcome back — we'll make the first three weeks low-friction.

Jordan
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
